extraction.name: Video-As-Prompt: Unified Semantic Control for Video Generation
extraction.description: Unified, generalizable semantic control in video generation remains a critical open challenge. We introduce Video-As-Prompt (VAP), a new paradigm that reframes this problem as in-context generation. VAP leverages a reference video as a direct semantic prompt, guiding a frozen Video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) via a plug-and-play Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) expert. This architecture prevents catastrophic forgetting and is guided by a temporally biased position embedding that eliminates spurious mapping priors for robust context retrieval. To power this approach and catalyze future research, we built VAP-Data, the largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation with over 100K paired videos across 100 semantic conditions.

extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu
extraction.publisher: Intelligent Creation Lab, ByteDance, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Semantic-controlled video generation requires paired reference and target videos sharing the same non-pixel-aligned semantic controls (e.g., concept, style, motion, camera). To address the lack of such pairs, we collected 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. We then used Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU [68] and Kling [40]) and community LoRAs [11] to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates (some restrict subject categories). This process resulted in VAP-Data, a semantic-controlled paired dataset with over 100K samples across 100 semantic conditions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU [68] and Kling [40]) and community LoRAs [11] were used to create paired videos by matching each collected image to all compatible templates.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Videos were resized to 480 × 720 (832) and sampled at 49 frames at 16fps.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset consists of paired reference and target videos sharing the same non-pixel-aligned semantic controls. These semantic conditions (e.g., concept, style, motion, camera) were generated by applying visual effects templates from commercial models (VIDU [68], Kling [40]) and community LoRAs [11,27,70,76] to curated reference images.

extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Commercial APIs (VIDU [68], Kling [40]) and community LoRAs [11,27,70,76]
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Reference images collected from the Internet include subjects such as men, women, and children.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: VAP targets semantic-controlled video generation for research, education, and creative prototyping. It is not intended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments. Potential misuses include identity impersonation, “deepfake” content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media. Mitigations include a research-only release and default content filters blocking clearly harmful categories (e.g., sexual content, explicit violence, hate symbols).
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The semantic conditions in VAP-Data are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models, which may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., if the source models are poor at generating hands, VAP will likely not learn to generate hands well from this data).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: 1. The semantic conditions in VAP-Data are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models, which may inherit specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates. The construction of larger-scale, real, semantic-controlled video data is left for future work. 2. VAP's performance depends on caption quality and structural similarity between main subjects. Inaccurate semantic descriptions or large subject mismatches between reference and target captions can degrade generation quality. Instruction-style captions may more effectively capture intended semantics and improve control. 3. The added parameters of the Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) expert introduce extra inference cost, roughly doubling runtime, though this is considered acceptable given the benefits.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning. Usage Guidelines: The dataset is intended for research, education, and creative prototyping. It is not intended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments. Any artifact release will be accompanied by a research-only license and an acceptable-use policy (AUP) that explicitly prohibits abusive or unlawful scenarios.
